column1: # Sequential Kalay palace reunion: Ivan returns, Hammet's detention discovered, ransom and proposed rescue.
# Runtime actor placeholders and yes/no continuation controls preserved.

column3: We'll welcome travelers\nagain when Lord Hammet\ncomes home. Until then, the{page_break}palace is closed.{end_wait}
Let me speak to them.{end_wait}
Please. I need to see Lady\nLayana. She'll want to hear\nwhat I know.{end_wait}
Don't you recognize me? I'm\n{actor_name:3}. I serve Lord\nHammet.{end_wait}
{actor_name:3}? Is that really\nyou?{end_wait}
Look at you! You've been\nout in the sun. I almost\ndidn't recognize you,{page_break}{actor_name:3}.{end_wait}
It is you, {actor_name:3}! You've\nchanged so much, {actor_name:3}!{end_wait}
Do I really look that\ndifferent?{end_now}
Really? I hadn't noticed.\nIt hasn't felt like a long\njourney.{end_wait}
You only met me after I was\nleft in Vault. Of course I\nlook the same to you.{end_wait}
Never mind that. You're\nback! Did those thieves\nfinally let you go?{end_wait}
And Lord Hammet? Is he\ncoming home too?{end_wait}
Coming home? Wait. Are you\nsaying Lord Hammet is being\nheld prisoner?{end_wait}
You haven't heard. Then we\nneed to explain. But this\nconcerns the palace. Could{page_break}your friends wait outside?{end_now}
No, {actor_name:1}. They've\nhelped me all this way. I\nwon't send them away.{end_wait}
We've faced danger\ntogether. They deserve to\nhear the truth.{end_wait}
All right. Tell us why you\nwere separated from Lord\nHammet.{end_wait}
I stayed in Vault to find\nthe rod thieves had stolen\nfrom him.{end_wait}
Someone stole his rod?{end_wait}
The Shaman's Rod. I got it\nback, but Hammet had\nalready gone north.{end_wait}
Then he must still be in\nLunpa. That means the\nransom didn't free him.{end_wait}
Lady Layana needs to hear\nthis at once.{end_wait}
Come with me, {actor_name:3}. You\ncan tell her what happened.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, you saw Lord\nHammet heading north,\ndidn't you?{end_now}
Then that must have been\nwhen he was taken toward\nLunpa.{end_wait}
No, I meant the day Hammet\nset out for Lunpa. Think\nback.{end_wait}
Lady Layana will want the\nfull account. Please, come\nwith us.{end_wait}
When I heard you were back,\n{actor_name:3}, I let myself hope\nHammet had returned too.{end_wait}
We thought the ransom would\nbring him home. We had no\nreason to think otherwise.{end_wait}
We paid what they demanded.\nSurely they have to release\nhim now.{end_wait}
Tell me about Lunpa. What\nhas happened to the town?{end_wait}
Lunpa founded it long ago.\nThen his son Donpa took\ncharge. Now Donpa's son,{page_break}Dodonpa, rules there.{end_wait}
Dodonpa's men have turned\nLunpa into a place people\nfear. Even his father is{page_break}ashamed.{end_wait}
When was the ransom paid?{end_wait}
Shortly after Mt. Aleph\nerupted, if I remember\ncorrectly.{end_wait}
The ransom demand came just\nafter the eruption.{end_wait}
We sent the money straight\naway. I remember because\nthere was no time to{page_break}prepare.{end_wait}
Then it's been a long time.\nHe should be home by now.{end_wait}
What if Dodonpa never\nintended to release him?{end_now}
You believe that too,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_wait}
I wish I could dismiss it,\nbut it's been far too long.{end_wait}
You think they mean to keep\nHammet, even after taking\nour money?{end_wait}
I agree with {actor_name:3}. If\nthey were going to free\nhim, they'd have done it.{end_wait}
Lady Layana, I'm afraid\n{actor_name:3} may be right.{end_wait}
Then what are we supposed\nto do? How do we bring him\nhome?{end_wait}
What if they've hurt him?\nWhat if we're already too\nlate?{end_wait}
Give us the order. We'll\ngo.{end_wait}
Protecting Kalay is our\nduty. That includes\nbringing its lord home.{end_wait}
Lady Layana, our soldiers\nare ready. Let us handle\nthis.{end_wait}
Say the word and we'll\nmarch on Lunpa.{end_wait}
